title: 加州立法者一致通过Linux年龄验证法豁免，开源许可证软件获例外
summary: 加州立法者一致通过了一项对Linux及其他开源软件（依据GPL、MIT、BSD和Apache许可证分发）的年龄验证法律豁免。该法律旨在要求在线平台对用户进行年龄验证以保护未成年人，但开源软件社区担忧其可能对开发者造成负担并限制自由软件分发。此次豁免意味着这些许可证下的软件无需执行年龄验证，从而减轻了合规压力。该决定被视为开源社区的一次重要胜利，平衡了未成年人保护与技术创新。法案仍需州长签署，但立法者的全票通过显示了广泛支持。此举可能影响其他州或国家的类似立法，为开源软件的法律环境树立先例。
summary_en: California lawmakers unanimously passed an exemption from the age-verification law for Linux and other open-source software distributed under GPL, MIT, BSD, and Apache licenses. The law originally required online platforms to verify user ages to protect minors, but the open-source community feared it would burden developers and restrict free software distribution. The exemption relieves these software projects from compliance, marking a significant win for the open-source community while balancing child safety. The bill awaits the governor's signature, and its unanimous passage suggests strong support. This could influence similar legislation elsewhere, setting a precedent for open-source legal treatment.
